newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-TEICHMANN FIT TO LEAD UNCHANGED SPRINGBOKS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-TEICHMANN FIT TO LEAD UNCHANGED SPRINGBOKS.

text.p: South African captain Gary Teichmann was passed fit on Wednesday as coach Andre Markgraaff named an unchanged team for the test against Wales on Sunday.
Teichmann suffered severe bruising to his ribs during Saturday's second test victory over France in Paris and was in danger of missing the match in Cardiff.

However, he was able to take part in Wednesday's training session and was named in the side which, having already beaten both Argentina and France in 2-0 series wins, remains unchanged for the fifth consecutive test -- a record for South Africa.

Lock Mark Andrews, also recovered from a rib injury, and flanker Ruben Kruger, who suffered a badly bruised knee in Paris, also took a full part in practice, although hooker James Dalton sat it out and faces a late fitness test on a shoulder injury.
Markgraaff played down the idea that Sunday's game would be an end of season festival match for the Springboks who have already played 13 tests this year.
"It has been a long year and maybe it would have been nice to have gone home after beating France last weekend. But we are in Wales and this is a test match we must win," he said.
"There is a job to be done on Sunday and we are ready for it."

Team - 15-Andre Joubert; 14-James Small, 13-Japie Mulder, 12-Hennie le Roux, 11-Jacques Olivier; 10-Henry Honiball, 9-Joost van der Westhuizen; 8-Gary Teichmann (captain), 7-Andre Venter, 6-Ruben Kruger, 5-Mark Andrews, 4-Kobus Wiese, 3-Adrian Garvey, 2-James Dalton, 1-Dawie Theron
